summary.en: You receive the key after you sign the lease and pay the costs due at signing. When you receive the key, check the condition of the room, if possible together with the real estate agent. Draw the damaged or dirty places on a simple floor plan and attach dated photographs to avoid trouble later. Apply for electricity, gas, water and internet with each company or the waterworks bureau. Ask the real estate agent first whether the property uses set companies, and check the start date and how to apply. Someone must be present when the gas is turned on. Garbage rules differ by area: when you move in, ask about the day, time, place and how to separate. Garbage not set out at the appointed time is not collected, even if separated correctly. In apartment buildings, be careful about noise late at night and early in the morning, and do not leave things in corridors and stairs. Tenants repair damage or stains they cause on purpose or by carelessness. You do not pay for wear from age or ordinary use (national guideline; to be checked). Within 14 days after you start living there, notify your new address (in Nagoya, at the ward office). The kind of notification and what to bring depend on where you moved from (choose under "Address notification" below). Check the lease and ask the real estate agent (to be checked).
